verdict.rationale: Self-hosted Kubernetes deployment is a fair axis for a vector database, since many vector databases ship Helm charts or operators, so the story applies. The evidence pack covers only Pinecone's managed serverless service, console, SDKs and MCP server. Nothing mentions a Helm chart, Kubernetes operator or self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator
